definitions.explanation: Crab meat preserved in a can — a common ingredient for salads, fried rice, and other dishes when fresh crab is unavailable.

examples.japanese: カニ{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: To open a can of crab.

examples.japanese: ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カニ{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To add canned crab to a salad.

examples.japanese: カニ{缶|かん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Canned crab is expensive, so we use it on special occasions.

notes:
USAGE: カニ{缶|かん} is canned (tinned) crab meat, combining カニ (crab) with ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧ (can). It is a convenient substitute for fresh crab in cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カニ{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a can of crab
- カニ{缶詰|かんづ}め: canned crab (as a product)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{缶詰|かんづめ}→缶詰：00187_kanzume⟧: canned food — the general category
- ズワイガニ: snow crab — a crab often used for canning
